findings.title: dropped data key collides with a CLI-injected key in dropUnknownDataKeys
findings.disposition_rationale: Every key the CLI injects (tokens, tokens_source, ledger_sha256_before/after, ledger_sha256) is in the schema of every type it can be injected on, so it is never dropped; agent-dispatch and runner-identity extras are refused by eventViolations before the drop runs. Overwriting a caller-supplied tokens or ledger_sha256 value predates this change (FAFF-408, FAFF-564).

findings.title: sentry-checkpoint append swallows non-schema errors in the sentry-poller abort tick
findings.disposition_rationale: The checkpoint append was a bare best-effort catch before this change; the slice adds logging for EVENT_SCHEMA as the spec requires and leaves other faults on their existing best-effort path.

findings.title: clientAdmit runs the schema check before the signature check
findings.disposition_rationale: verifyAdmitReply runs first and returns its own signature/fingerprint message; governorRecordConforms runs only after it passes, so a forged record is reported as a signature failure.

findings.title: evidence_seq_range has no maxItems outside the TypeScript writer
findings.disposition_rationale: The subset validator has no maxItems (spec). Every conclusion writer path runs conclusionRangeViolations: appendCommissaireRecord in-process and governorRecordConforms on governor records. A hand-crafted line is mint-time enforcement, FAFF-1261's scope.

findings.title: under a second profile --tokens overwrites a caller tokens key without a warning
findings.disposition_rationale: Pre-existing --tokens behaviour, unchanged; the spec skips the payload drop and check under a profile override.

findings.title: appendEffectEntries reports an extra descriptor key as a schema violation
findings.disposition_rationale: The violation names the field (effect: additional property "colour" not allowed) under scope schema[i]; wording only.

findings.title: the unavailable marker records only the first degraded writer
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec defines the marker as {first_at, writer, path}, written once by the first degraded write.

findings.title: agent-dispatch data keys could drift from DISPATCH_ALLOWED_DATA_KEYS
findings.disposition_rationale: test/evidence-payload-coverage.test.mjs asserts the agent-dispatch data key set equals DISPATCH_ALLOWED_DATA_KEYS and the runner-identity set equals the events.js allow-list.
